newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber won't comment on stock - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber won't comment on stock - NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that PaineWebber Group Inc declined to comment on a rise in the company's stock price.
PaineWebber told the exchange that it had a policy of making no comment on unusual market activity or rumors.
Hitting a new 52-week high, PaineWebber's shares traded at 38-3/8, up 2-5/8. About 934,500 shares changed hands, compared with an average daily volume of about 360,000 shares.

PaineWebber's shares surged on Friday amid market talk that Morgan Stanley might make a bid for the company. But Morgan Stanley Group Inc said it was not in any talks to acquire PaineWebber. BankAmerica Corp has also been mentioned as a possible suitor, but it has declined comment on the speculation.
